name: redwood-light
title: Redwood light
description: A redwood forest in early morning: giant trunks fading into blue-green haze, golden light shafts slanting onto a fern floor, and slow motes drifting in the light.

name: balloon-valley
title: Balloon valley
description: Sunrise over a river valley in halftone dots: layered hills fading into haze, mist on the valley floor, a river catching the low sun and hot-air balloons hanging at different depths.
